quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Conclusion of a Memorandum of Understanding Regarding (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner TDK: on September 29, 2026 Taiyo Yuden concluded a memorandum of understanding with TDK to begin exploring a comprehensive business alliance centered on joint development of advanced electronic components, including cutting-edge MLCCs and inductors for AI data centers and physical AI, and encompassing cooperation in manufacturing and procurement; the companies will discuss specific areas and roles, consider a possible future capital alliance, and consider a joint supply assurance plan and joint application to the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (MLCCs are designated Specified Critical Products under the Economic Security Promotion Act). Company expects only a minor impact on FY ending March 2027 results; no existing capital, personnel or noteworthy business relationship with TDK.
quarterly_data.figure: MOU signed September 29, 2026; minor impact on FY3/2027 results
